full_name: Lizzy Cooper Davis | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2016–2017 Radcliffe Institute Graduate Student Fellow Harvard University
bio: Lizzy Cooper Davis is a doctoral candidate in Harvard University’s Department of African and African American Studies. Her interests include the anthropology of race, black Atlantic performance and spiritual traditions, critical race theory, and the role of the arts in social movements.
